svg.aria-label: Ecosystem map: synthwerk (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk). Blueprint: Shared CI, lint configs and templates: synthwerk-blueprint (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk-blueprint). The old UI: The tag legacy-final holds the old code: a Vuetify landing page with a placeholder login. S-E0 and E4: S-E0 replaced it with the Synthwerk skeleton. Epic E4 Studio core is the rewrite.
